messages.text: Does the Thor p2 mine btc and Bitcoin cash simultaneously without splitting the hash rate?

No. The T. P2 is a SHA-256 miner, and BTC and BCH are separate chains, so it can only work on one at a time. There's no way to mine both at full rate at once, on this unit or any other.

What some pools do is auto-switch to whichever is more profitable, or pay you in BCH while you point the hashrate at BTC. The hashrate still only goes to one chain.

Is BCH payout what you're after, or actually mining the BCH chain?
Ok but the hemmerminer dc06 can mine ltc doge and Pepe simultaneously correct?

Mostly yes. The D.06 is a Scrypt miner, and Litecoin and Dogecoin are merge-mined, so the same 330 MH/s works both chains at once with no split. That part is real.

Pepecoin is also Scrypt merge-mined, so pools that support it add it on top the same way. It depends on the pool you point at, not the miner. Something like LitecoinPool does LTC plus DOGE; for PEPE too you'd want a pool that lists it.

Want me to build the cart?
So the thor p2 can only mine btc at one time and not any other coins listed?

Right, one chain at a time. It can point at any SHA-256 coin, BTC, Bitcoin Cash, Digibyte's SHA-256 chain, but you pick one and all 10 TH/s goes there. Switching is just changing the pool.

The S. side is the one with real merge mining, which is why the DC06 gets LTC, DOGE and PEPE together.

If stacking several coins at once matters to you, the DC06 is the better fit. Want both, or just that one?
